name: 319-cross-lang-create
description: Cross-language self-construction: a C trigger box uses the runtime API to create a LUA box at runtime. The Lua spec isn't in the static graph's language set, so the worker's Lua handle is NULL at pool startup. The dispatch's lazy-init kicks in on the new box's invoke and populates the handle on demand. Verifies issue 319's auto-init follow-on.
